improvement_candidates.target: auto-net preflight/runtime policy parity for docker ps
improvement_candidates.evidence: The auto-net preflight overlay allowed the read-only docker ps representative case, while a fresh actual auto-net runtime applied common project rules and approval=never rejected it before execution.

evidence_refs.summary: preflight overlay allow contrasted with actual runtime prompt rejection

improvement_candidates.expected_impact: Keep the preflight decision aligned with the effective session policy or clearly surface the difference so auto-net users do not infer that a preflight allow means the runtime will execute the command.
improvement_candidates.recommendation: Create a separate L3 decision to either remove the docker ps allowance from the auto-net overlay or design and verify an appropriate runtime policy alignment. Do not add a preset-specific runtime loader in this PR.
